title: Later band replacements and Signorelli's recordings
summary: He names Seboyg and Vanacella as replacements for Lytel and Signorelli, then answers a question about Signorelli's recordings with the band and his letters to Brian Rust.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You asked me that I forgot to say who replaced Lytel and Signorelli. Two New York boys, they were both from Brooklyn. One was Artie Seboyg and the other was Henry Vanacella. He played the flam net and Vanacella played the piano. Now, each change I made, I didn't come to New Orleans. Although I was relegated in a dance hall.
What about Signer Running? You say he made some records.

Oh yes, he recorded with us in the latter part of our contact with the victim. The numbers offhand I can't tell you, but if you look through the files, you'll find out I have letters that I sent to this Brian Russ, and I tell him about the men who played on the recording.
